summary: 'I love you' as a phrase is I LOVE YOU in three signs, or the single ILY handshape (thumb, index, and pinky up) which is the most recognized sign in the world.
steps: For the quick version: extend your thumb, index finger, and pinky, keeping the middle and ring fingers down. Hold it up, palm out.
For the full sentence: point to yourself (I), cross both fists over your heart (LOVE), point to the person (YOU).
Use the handshape for casual affection, the full sentence when you mean it.
note: The ILY handshape combines the letters I, L, and Y into one shape. It's widely used among hearing people too, which is fine; just know it's a sign with a real meaning, not a gesture.
mistakes: Extending the middle finger instead of the pinky. Check the clip.
Confusing it with the rock-and-roll horns, which lack the thumb.

faq.q: Is the I-love-you hand sign the same as rock horns?
faq.a: No. The ILY handshape has the thumb out. Rock horns tuck the thumb in. The thumb is the difference.
